monitor_policy: The monitor reads package status once per minute and emits progress. Use functions.wait on cell 608 with yield_time_ms 60000. Do not run another status poll while it owns monitoring.
monitor_exit: The monitor returns detailed state on a lost build-5 pass, a failed final-pass step, or completed comparison. It never stops the test process.
remaining: Finish packaged tree/base qualification, coverage and comparison; inspect gaps/regressions; run final verification and reporting scripts listed in RESUME.md.
